EquityQuote is contracted to the stock security type, so a quote payload that answers 'AAPL' with type='etf' must be refused by transform_data as TRADIER_WRONG_SECURITY_TYPE instead of being emitted as a stock quote; untampered control produced 1 row(s) through the same seam

a search result is identified by (symbol, exchange), so two listings that both name AAPL on NASDAQ are the same catalog row twice and transform_data must refuse the whole page instead of emitting a duplicated security; untampered control produced 2 row(s) through the same seam

the chain was requested for one expiration, so a contract row carrying a different expiration_date than the query would mislabel the expiry of a whole page and must be refused by transform_data as TRADIER_WRONG_EXPIRATION; untampered control produced 2 row(s) through the same seam
